Initial release of Free Video Generation Professional.

- Instantly convert a 200-word product description or 30-second clip into a professional 1080p MP4 video for free.
- No manual editing: simply upload text prompts or clips and describe the desired result.
- Fast cloud rendering pipeline returns videos in 1–2 minutes.
- Supports video, audio, and text tracks with automatic session and credit management.
- Intuitive command-based workflow for previewing, editing, exporting, and checking credits.
